description: Methodology for literature reviews in DAAF, organized by three levels the researcher picks at the start: quick scan (abstracts and a short memo of pointers), standard review (full reads of key papers, page-checked claims, a stated weight per paper, calibrated wording) and formal or systematic review (researcher-led protocol, second screener, checklist guides for RoB 2, ROBINS-I V2, ROBINS-E, WWC, AMSTAR 2, JBI and CASP, GRADE-style certainty). Covers choosing a review type and level, screening, per-paper notes, citation snowballing, synthesis without pooling or vote counting, labeled descriptive summaries, the certainty phrase table (certainty-language.yaml) and the gap register. Use when planning, screening, appraising, synthesizing or reporting a literature review, or wording what a body of evidence shows. Not for running searches (scholarly-search), reading PDFs (pdf-reading), causal verbs for one's own results (data-scientist), or lay audiences (science-communication).
